info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List Webhooks API

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: order_by
params.description: (Optional) List Webhooks corresponding to specific criteria.

params.name: page
params.description: (Optional) Requested page number. Value must be greater or equal to 1.

params.name: page_size
params.description: (Optional) Requested page size. Value must be between 1 and 100.

params.name: project_id
params.description: (Optional) ID of the Project for which to list the Webhooks. (UUID format)

params.name: organization_id
params.description: (Optional) ID of the Organization for which to list the Webhooks. (UUID format)

params.name: domain_id
params.description: (Optional) ID of the Domain for which to list the Webhooks. (UUID format)

items.docs: Retrieve Webhooks in a specific Project or in a specific Organization using the `region` parameter.
